integrity: The theorem is supported by an analytic dominated-convergence and stopped-walk comparison proof, with finite independent-style numerical integral checks as reproducibility aids only.
limitations: Proves weak first-passage convergence for independent Mittag-Leffler rate refreshment on a one-dimensional symmetric nearest-neighbor half-line walk; does not assert uniformity over indefinitely many blocks, moment convergence, or independent validation.
title: Logistic-geometric first-passage crossover under extreme Mittag-Leffler jump-rate fluctuations
